metadata.title: Container Orchestration Security

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing how containerized workloads are admitted, scheduled, authorized, isolated, and constrained by an orchestration control plane.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container orchestration platforms, control planes, admission systems, workload metadata, and policy engines.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes security, authorization, and policy enforcement at the container orchestration layer.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Orchestration security assumes the underlying container platform is trusted.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Container orchestration security and control-plane threats.

metadata.remarks: Container Orchestration Security defines trust properties enforced by orchestration control planes. It governs workload admission, authorization, placement, tenancy boundaries, and policy enforcement, without asserting container runtime or supply‑chain controls.

components.title: Workload Admission Control
components.description: Validation of security, policy, and trust criteria before workloads are scheduled.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Admission of malicious or untrusted container artifacts into the orchestration environment.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Validation of workload artifacts and metadata prior to execution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict and validate changes to workload deployment configuration.
Integrity validation of workload definitions and inputs.

components.title: Orchestration Access Control
components.description: Governance of who may deploy, modify, or interact with orchestrated workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid orchestration identities or roles.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role‑ and identity‑based access control for orchestration operations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Account and role management for orchestration control planes.
Least privilege for users and service accounts interacting with the orchestrator.

components.title: Namespace and Tenancy Governance
components.description: Isolation of workloads by logical tenancy, environment, and trust zone.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement across improperly isolated namespaces or tenants.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logical isolation of workload namespaces and tenancy boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow controls enforcing tenancy separation.

components.title: Workload Security Policy Enforcement
components.description: Application of centrally governed security policies to orchestrated workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Bypass or weakening of orchestration‑level security policies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Consistent enforcement of security policies during workload scheduling and operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security policies governing workload deployment and operation.
Continuous monitoring of policy compliance across workloads.

components.title: Workload Network Policy Enforcement
components.description: Controls and restricts east-west network communication between orchestrated workloads.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network segmentation within container orchestration environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement between containerized workloads via unrestricted east-west network paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-based restriction of network communication paths between orchestrated workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection for east-west communication between orchestrated workloads.
Information flow control enforced via workload-level network policy.
